scientific_integrity: Every candidate in the claimed finite range is covered: parity proves that an odd pseudo-prime parameter forces the ordinary component to be a square, reducing the exhaustive domain to odd roots \(m\le10^9\). The packaged segmented sieve factors every such root and performs the divisor-sum test with exact integer arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: Finite verification through the ordinary component cutoff \(q=10^{18}\) only. The result does not prove uniqueness of Descartes' example and does not cover signed, repeated-base, or multiperfect spoof generalizations.
title: The ordinary component of any new Descartes number exceeds \(10^{18}\)
